atoms.exact_source_text: Permanent claimed or built ground within Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Place is defined as permanent claimed or built ground within Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: Location, footprint, species-spatial relationship, hosted use
atoms.normalized_claim: A Place's persistent state includes location, footprint, species-spatial relationship, and hosted use.

atoms.exact_source_text: Repeated communal activity sustained by one or more Roles and hosted in a Place.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Practice is defined as repeated communal activity sustained by one or more Roles and hosted in a Place.

atoms.exact_source_text: Active civic purpose
atoms.normalized_claim: A Practice's persistent state is its active civic purpose.

atoms.exact_source_text: A named commitment of Citizen time and Resources producing a predictable persistent result.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Project is defined as a named commitment of Citizen time and Resources producing a predictable persistent result.

atoms.exact_source_text: Specific completed change
atoms.normalized_claim: A Project's persistent state is a specific completed change.

atoms.exact_source_text: Once ground becomes a Place, it remains part of the Colony.
atoms.normalized_claim: Once ground becomes a Place, it remains part of the Colony (canonical rule).

atoms.exact_source_text: A Place may change use or stand vacant, but it cannot be demolished back into neutral ground.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Place may change use or stand vacant, but it cannot be demolished back into neutral ground (canonical rule).

atoms.exact_source_text: A Place may host a Residence, host a Practice, or remain vacant.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Place may host a Residence, host a Practice, or remain vacant.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species spatial bonuses calculate against the Place itself, independent of hosted use.
atoms.normalized_claim: Species spatial bonuses calculate against the Place itself, independent of hosted use.

atoms.exact_source_text: Mouse JOIN, Rabbit GATHER, and Squirrel CONNECT remain the governing spatial expressions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Mouse JOIN, Rabbit GATHER, and Squirrel CONNECT remain the governing spatial expressions.

atoms.exact_source_text: No universal adjacency-bonus puzzle, aura grid, or hidden optimization layer is added.
atoms.normalized_claim: No universal adjacency-bonus puzzle, aura grid, or hidden optimization layer is added.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Practice is not necessarily one-to-one with a Role or Place.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Practice is not necessarily one-to-one with a Role or Place.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Workshop may support Builder and Crafter activity.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Workshop may support Builder and Crafter activity.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Gathering Place hosts Teaching, Chronicle and Citizen Tale access, Keepsakes, naming, Laws and Sayings, cultural transmission, and accelerated rearing.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Gathering Place hosts Teaching, Chronicle and Citizen Tale access, Keepsakes, naming, Laws and Sayings, cultural transmission, and accelerated rearing.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Community Board visually represents selected Almanac information in DWELL once constructed
atoms.normalized_claim: The Community Board visually represents selected Almanac information in DWELL once constructed.

atoms.exact_source_text: the Almanac remains menu-accessible before and after it exists.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Almanac remains menu-accessible before and after the Community Board exists.

atoms.exact_source_text: Community Board, Council, Almanac | Gathering Place, Teaching, Chronicle, Citizen Tales
atoms.normalized_claim: Present Colony features Community Board, Council, and Almanac map to Colony-through-time features Gathering Place, Teaching, Chronicle, and Citizen Tales.

atoms.exact_source_text: Projects consume predictable Citizen time and Resources.
atoms.normalized_claim: Projects consume predictable Citizen time and Resources.

atoms.exact_source_text: Projects construct or alter Places and Practices, create Away Tools and Supplies, perform repairs or Tier work, and establish specific persistent facts.
atoms.normalized_claim: Projects construct or alter Places and Practices, create Away Tools and Supplies, perform repairs or Tier work, and establish specific persistent facts.

atoms.exact_source_text: The former Construction Queue is the Project Queue.
atoms.normalized_claim: The former Construction Queue is now called the Project Queue.

atoms.exact_source_text: Projects cannot be interrupted or cancelled after commitment.
atoms.normalized_claim: Projects cannot be interrupted or cancelled after commitment.

atoms.exact_source_text: Normal Projects should not create excessively long lockouts
atoms.normalized_claim: Normal Projects should not create excessively long lockouts.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier work may be longer.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tier work may be longer than normal Project lockouts.
